title: Model perf profiles: add FP8/INT8 recommended defaults by model family
author: Arjun Desai
body:
Summary: Updates model performance profile entries to include FP8 and INT8 recommended defaults per model family (Llama/Qwen/Mistral) and per GPU class where it meaningfully changes (H100/H200 vs A100 vs L40S). This is consumed by the runtime config generator / console “recommended settings” and is intended to make the quantized paths opt-in-but-safe during the FP8/INT8 kernel benchmarking sprint.

Motivation: During the sprint we’ve been running A/Bs with a moving set of flags (kernel family overrides, FP8 format policy, INT8 conversion/fusion toggles). The current registry profiles only capture FP16/throughput notes, so teams are copy/pasting settings from Slack threads and benchmark configs. This PR centralizes the “known-good default” set with explicit fallbacks and guardrails.

What’s in this PR: 1) Adds quant_recommended_defaults to model-family profile templates, including: FP8: preferred fp8_format (e4m3 vs e5m2), accumulation dtype policy, and kernel_family preference ordering; INT8: weight quant granularity (per-channel), activation path notes, and preferred fused dequant kernel families; 2) Encodes GPU-conditional overrides: H100/H200 prefer fp8_attention_v2 + fp8_gemm_fused, A100 prefers fp16_attention + int8_gemm_fused (FP8 allowed but not defaulted), L40S defaults to INT8 only due to intermittent FP8 correctness observed in perf canary; 3) Adds explicit “safe fallback” behavior notes for long-context prefill and for unsupported ops (route to FP16 kernel path rather than failing); 4) Documents the provenance of these defaults: benchmark-lab matrix run IDs, runtime commits, and Applied ML drift checks.

Recommended defaults (high level): Llama-family (chat/completions): H100/H200: FP8 on by default for attention+GEMM, fp8_format=e4m3 for weights with conservative scaling policy; INT8 optional for decode-heavy workloads; A100: INT8 default for GEMM-heavy decode, FP8 marked “experimental”; L40S: INT8 default only. Qwen-family: H100/H200: FP8 default for GEMM; attention FP8 default only for short/medium context; long-context prefill recommends FP16 attention until the alignment fix is broadly rolled out; Mistral-family: H100/H200: FP8 default across attention+GEMM; A100: INT8 default; L40S: INT8 default with reduced fusion set.

Validation: Registry schema validation passes; golden snapshot tests updated; ran local config generation against top hosted models and verified that produced runtime flags match benchmark harness presets. Applied ML drift guardrail summary linked below.

Rollout/operational notes: This PR only changes recommended defaults surfaced by the registry. It does not force-enable quant in runtime. Release eng can choose to adopt the updated recommendations in a controlled manner (Dedicated first, then Hosted cohorts) and can pin previous defaults per model version if needed.

Links: Linear ENG-24810 (sprint umbrella), ENG-24819 (correctness guardrail). Related runtime PRs: redwood#10622, redwood#10623, redwood#10630, redwood#10635. Benchmark configs: benchmark-lab configs tagged quant_sprint_v1.

Risk assessment: Medium. Incorrect defaults can steer customers into slower or less stable paths. Mitigations: conservative GPU gating, explicit fallback to FP16 paths, and L40S FP8 disabled by default pending canary stability.
commits: Add quant_recommended_defaults fields to model family templates
Encode GPU-conditional overrides for H100/H200 vs A100 vs L40S
Update schema + validation and refresh golden snapshots
Docs: add provenance links (bench run IDs, drift check summary) to profiles
conversation:
Grace Kim (review): Can we be more explicit about FP8 format choice? Right now it just says e4m3 “preferred”. Which workloads should use e5m2?

Arjun Desai (author): Good call. I added a note: e5m2 is only recommended for a small set of activation-sensitive models/workloads (currently none of the top hosted presets), and we default to e4m3 with conservative scaling. Also clarified that the runtime may override based on capability detection.

Noah Patel (review): Please add a hard guard for L40S FP8 given the intermittent correctness issue. Recommendation should be INT8-only until perf-canary is clean for 7 days.

Arjun Desai (author): Done. Added gpu_overrides.l40s.fp8_enabled=false and linked to the canary incident note in the profile comments. Also ensured the config generator will not emit FP8 defaults for L40S.

Jonas Weber (review): Can you reference drift thresholds / eval coverage? I want this to be defensible if a customer asks “why this default”.

Arjun Desai (author): Added a short “quality guardrail” section to each family profile pointing to the drift check suite (INT8/FP8 vs FP16) and the thresholds we used (relative logprob drift + output similarity on the small prompt set). Also added a note that this is not a full quality certification.

Connor O'Brien (review): Release note: mention that these are recommendations only and can be pinned per model version.

Arjun Desai (author): Added to PR release notes and README.

Grace Kim (final): LGTM after latest push.

Noah Patel (final): Approved.
CI summary: validate_profiles ✅, unit-tests ✅, snapshot-tests ✅, lint ✅. One flaky snapshot job on first run due to line ending normalization; rerun passed.
Merged by Arjun Desai via squash merge.
release_notes:
- Model registry now exposes FP8/INT8 recommended defaults by model family and GPU class.
- L40S defaults remain INT8-only; FP8 is not recommended until correctness canary is stable.
- Recommendations include explicit fallback notes for unsupported ops/long-context prefill.
